# API Contracts Checklist: SPEC-013A Run-State Persistence Spine

**Purpose**: Validate API-contract requirements for the task-scoped stage-attempt inspection route, workspace masking, response vocabulary, read-only boundaries, and future SPEC-013B/C reuse.
**Created**: 2026-05-22
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: Generated by the `/speckit.checklist api-contracts` workflow. Gap items found during generation were remediated in `spec.md`, `plan.md`, and `contracts/task-stage-attempts-api.md`; this checklist records the post-remediation requirement-quality state without active gap markers.

## Route Identity And Read Boundary

- [x] CHK001 Is the read route named as a dedicated task-scoped `GET /api/tasks/[id]/stage-attempts` surface rather than overloading task Evidence or adding a global dashboard? [Completeness, Spec §FR-020, Contract §GET]
- [x] CHK002 Are mutation boundaries explicit that the route cannot create, update, archive, claim, retry, release, cancel, launch, reconcile, schedule, or trigger hidden repair behavior? [Coverage, Spec §FR-012, Spec §FR-023, Contract §Auth]
- [x] CHK003 Are query parameters limited to existing workspace-scope selectors with no action or mutation parameters accepted? [Clarity, Contract §Query Parameters]

## Auth, Masking, And Error Contract

- [x] CHK004 Are viewer-or-higher auth and workspace masking requirements specified for malformed scope, forbidden explicit scope, nonexistent tasks, and out-of-scope tasks? [Completeness, Spec §FR-016, Contract §Auth]
- [x] CHK005 Are masked `404 task_not_found` requirements clear enough to avoid leaking whether a task exists outside the caller's workspace scope? [Security, Spec §FR-016, Contract §Error Responses]
- [x] CHK006 Are error bodies and status codes represented with stable machine-readable vocabulary for `401`, `400`, `403`, and masked `404` outcomes? [Clarity, Contract §Error Responses]

## Success Envelope And Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK007 Does the contract define the exact `task_stage_attempts.v1` envelope shape with `task`, ordered `attempts`, and `warnings`? [Completeness, Spec §FR-020, Contract §Success Response]
- [x] CHK008 Is the visible-task/no-attempts response specified as `200` with the same envelope, `attempts: []`, and no omitted collection field? [Resolved, Spec §FR-025, Contract §No Attempts Response]
- [x] CHK009 Are active and archived attempts both covered with distinct status, timestamp, archive evidence, workflow-template context, and lifecycle-summary requirements? [Coverage, Spec §FR-008, Spec §FR-009, Data Model §Read Model]
- [x] CHK010 Are optional runtime-run link states complete for no link, linked same-workspace run summary, and missing/unavailable run summary? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005, Contract §Run Link States]
- [x] CHK011 Are invalid or future stored attempt/lifecycle states handled with safe read warnings rather than coercion, mutation, repair, or action controls? [Resolved, Spec §FR-025, Contract §Invalid Stored State Handling]

## Ordering, Bounds, And Payload Safety

- [x] CHK012 Are attempt ordering requirements deterministic by `stage_key` and latest attempt number? [Measurability, Contract §Attempt Ordering]
- [x] CHK013 Are lifecycle snippet ordering and maximum returned lifecycle-entry count specified so payload size and UI rendering remain bounded? [Resolved, Plan §Implementation Boundaries, Contract §Attempt Ordering]
- [x] CHK014 Are response strings and run summaries constrained to safe display fields without raw run steps, cost, eval, provenance, tags, tool payloads, storage URIs, or secret-bearing values? [Security, Contract §Security And Safety Requirements]

## Compatibility And Discoverability

- [x] CHK015 Are route names, envelope names, and response vocabulary generic enough for future SPEC-013B/C reuse without claim/retry/release/cancel/launch authority terms? [Consistency, Spec §FR-026, Contract §Security And Safety Requirements]
- [x] CHK016 Are API discoverability artifacts required to include the route as read-only viewer-authenticated task inspection? [Resolved, Spec §FR-026, Plan §Verification Plan]
- [x] CHK017 Are existing task Evidence route/table-blind requirements preserved alongside the new dedicated route? [Consistency, Spec §FR-020, Plan §Implementation Boundaries]
- [x] CHK018 Are verification expectations traceable from API contract scenarios through route tests, component states, Playwright UAT, OpenAPI/API index evidence, and static guardrails? [Traceability, Spec §SC-008, Spec §SC-011, Plan §Verification Plan]

## Gap Remediation Notes

- CHK008 resolved a missing explicit no-attempts `200` envelope.
- CHK011 resolved missing invalid stored-state response vocabulary.
- CHK013 resolved an unquantified lifecycle snippet bound.
- CHK016 resolved missing OpenAPI/API-index discoverability requirements.

## Re-run Validation

- [x] CHK019 Does the remediated contract now define a no-attempts `200` response without creating a special empty-body or not-found case? [Traceability, Contract §No Attempts Response, Spec §FR-025]
- [x] CHK020 Does the remediated contract now define safe invalid stored-state read behavior with warnings and no hidden repair mutation? [Traceability, Contract §Invalid Stored State Handling, Spec §FR-025]
- [x] CHK021 Does the remediated contract now quantify lifecycle snippet bounds while preserving deterministic chronological output ordering? [Measurability, Contract §Attempt Ordering, Plan §Implementation Boundaries]
- [x] CHK022 Does the remediated plan now require `openapi.json` and local API-index documentation for the new read-only route? [Traceability, Spec §FR-026, Plan §Verification Plan]
